title: Nixon Lady Mustangs Win Bi-District Championship, First in Nine Years
excerpt: The Nixon High School Lady Mustang volleyball team won the Bi-District Championship — the program’s first in nine years — and now advances to the Area round of the state playoffs against Smithson Valley High School.
content:
The Nixon High School Lady Mustang volleyball team won the Bi-District Championship, the program’s first in nine years, according to the Laredo Independent School District.

LISD Superintendent Guillermo Pro hosted a celebration luncheon for the team, the district reported. The luncheon was sponsored by Marty Speer, owner of Chick-fil-A Marketplace.

Next, the Lady Mustangs take on Smithson Valley High School in the Area round of the state playoffs, according to LISD.
